integrity_note: The all-n result is proved by the incidence criterion, minimal edge-cover argument, and labeled component enumeration. Finite tests provide diagnostics only. Separate independent audit or formal verification was not performed in the original research package.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary inclusion-minimal forts of J(n,2), for n>=3, not all forts or higher Johnson graphs. The minimum size for n>=5 follows from previously published Johnson failed-zero-forcing results. Historical priority for the all-size polynomial has residual uncertainty, particularly concerning an inaccessible 2024 Johnson-family article.
title: Minimal forts of triangular graphs: a cycle–star-forest classification
